lines.speaker: turkey
lines.text: Now, is that a spark, gone under the water?
lines.caption: A spark, gone under the water?

lines.speaker: turkey
lines.text: Oh, no. Or is that the calendar, tickin' on down to Thanksgivin'?
lines.caption: Or the calendar, ticking down to Thanksgiving?

lines.speaker: trout
lines.text: Looky there! A feather, fell clean outta the sky?
lines.caption: A feather, fallen out of the sky?

lines.speaker: trout
lines.text: Or a flare. Is somebody up yonder in trouble?
lines.caption: Or a flare: is somebody up there in trouble?
